entry.question: For Bringer’s would-be destruction, what Fear and Push happens for Explorer, Town and City? Does Mists of Oblivion’s bonus for buildings actually destroyed or Vengeance of the Dead trigger from it?

entry.answer: Would-destroy Explorer: zero Fear and Push; Town: 2 Fear and Push; City: 5 Fear, no Push. No real destruction, so no Mists actual-destruction bonus or Vengeance trigger from pretend deaths.
